card.name: Gap just before a number or list item
card.fires_on: Fires on a space or small linking mark (then, are, dash, hyphen, open parenthesis) right before the next item. Most often it is the space after "for" or a dose amount, just before a number of days.

modes.label: Space before duration
modes.description: The blank space after "for" or a dosing frequency, right before a number of days.
modes.example: The recommended dose of XIFAXAN is one 200 mg tablet taken orally three times a day for<< >>3 days.
